title: Make the design confirmation contract state its evidence and amendment rules
summary: The design confirmation contract made three claims that the repository did not honour. It said implemented and verified are written by development and release gates and never by the authoring step, but no gate writes either state and records in the repository carry them from creation. It did not say how an internal_only record, which needs no separate human decision, should register its approval status, even though the repository gate only credits changed paths to a record that is both in an implementation state and carrying an approved status. It also did not say whether descriptive text can be corrected after implementation begins, while section 5 declared the whole record immutable. This change states each rule in a decidable form: implemented and verified are claims that MUST name their evidence, states asserted before the rule are not retroactive, an internal_only record MUST register an approved status and name the standing decision it relies on without inventing an approval time, and a title or summary correction MUST land as its own visible commit. It also records in the CI support matrix that the fast and full profiles now enforce the authored-text language preflight before any test runs. Verification evidence: the change landed in 4351c55 and 7991d08, pushed on 2026-09-17 with 7991d08 as the publish point; CI run 35197028101 on 7991d08 passed all seven jobs (Fast 3.11, 3.12, 3.13; Full 3.11, 3.13; Install matrix 3.11, 3.13); locally fast reports 419 tests OK and full reports 432 tests OK, with the design confirmation, document boundary, and English text gates all returning 0; and @assayer_rev independently reviewed both commits and passed them.

platform: The platform owns the design confirmation contract, its state machine, and the verification profiles

forbiddenResponsibilities: The change must not weaken the requirement that a public-contract, semantic, safety, persistence, or release change carries human approval
The change must not allow an internal_only record to cover a path without an approved status
The change must not retroactively invalidate records created before the evidence rule
The change must not promote a superseded document or add a new normative document
acceptance: docs/design-confirmation-contract-v1.md states that implemented and verified MUST name their evidence
docs/design-confirmation-contract-v1.md states that an internal_only record MUST register an approved status naming its standing decision
docs/design-confirmation-contract-v1.md states that a title or summary correction MUST land as its own visible commit
docs/ci-support-matrix-v1.md states that fast and full enforce the authored-text language preflight
scripts/run_tests.py fast and full stay green

humanApproval.decision: Approved in #assayer-group:4c84ee19 on 2026-09-17 as items A, B, C, and D of the step-2 bundle. C was proposed with three options and the recommendation was option (c): state a decidable evidence rule without a record-schema migration.
